newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon, Executive, set major announcement.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon, Executive, set major announcement.

text.p: Executive Jet Inc said it and Raytheon Aircraft, a unit of Raytheon Co, will make a significant announcement at a media briefing on May 13 in New York at 1100 EDT/1500 GMT.
The company said the announcement will "further demonstrate the acceptance of the NetJets concept of fractional aircraft ownership," introduced by Executive Jet in 1986.
Richard Santulli, owner of Executive Jet, and Art Wegner, chairman and chief executive officer of Raytheon Aircraft, will be at the conference.
